# CWE-319: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information in IaC

## Core Weakness Categories to Detect

### 1. Insecure Protocol Usage
Indicators that unencrypted protocols are configured instead of their secure counterparts.

| Keyword / Attribute | Implication |
|---|---|
| `protocol: HTTP` / `http://` | Unencrypted web traffic |
| `protocol: FTP` / `ftp://` | Unencrypted file transfer |
| `protocol: TELNET` | Unencrypted remote access |
| `protocol: SMTP` (without TLS) | Unencrypted email transport |
| `port: 80`, `port: 21`, `port: 23`, `port: 25` | Common cleartext service ports |

---

### 2. HTTPS/TLS Enforcement Disabled
Flags or attributes that explicitly disable enforced encrypted transmission.

| Keyword / Attribute | Implication |
|---|---|
| `https_only: false` / `http_only_enabled: false` | Allows unencrypted HTTP traffic |
| `enable_https_traffic_only: false` | Storage/resource accepts HTTP |
| `require_ssl: false` / `ssl_required: false` | SSL not mandatory |
| `tls_enabled: false` / `ssl_enabled: false` | Transport encryption disabled |
| `enforce_https: false` | No HTTPS enforcement |
| `secure_transfer_enabled: false` | Unencrypted transfer permitted |
| `transit_encryption_enabled: false` | In-transit encryption off |
| `encryption_in_transit: disabled` | No encryption during data transfer |

---

### 3. Weak or Missing TLS Version Policy
Configurations permitting deprecated or broken TLS/SSL versions.

| Keyword / Attribute | Implication |
|---|---|
| `minimum_tls_version: TLS1_0` or `TLS1_1` | Allows use of deprecated TLS |
| `min_protocol_version: SSLv3` | Allows broken SSL protocol |
| `ssl_policy: ELBSecurityPolicy-2015-05` | Outdated/weak cipher policy |
| `tls_policy: minimum` | Non-restrictive TLS settings |
| `predefined_policy` referencing old standards | Supports deprecated protocols |

---

### 4. Listener/Endpoint Protocol Configuration
Load balancer, API gateway, or service listener settings that expose cleartext channels.

| Keyword / Attribute | Implication |
|---|---|
| `listener_protocol: HTTP` (without redirect rule) | Cleartext listener active |
| `default_action: forward` on port 80 (no redirect) | No HTTPS redirect enforced |
| `endpoint_type: HTTP` | Unencrypted API endpoint |
| `ingress_protocol: HTTP` | Unencrypted ingress |
| `frontend_protocol: HTTP` | Cleartext frontend communication |
| Missing `redirect_action` to HTTPS on port 80 | No automatic upgrade to TLS |

---

### 5. Database & Cache Transmission Security
Settings that allow database or cache connections without encryption.

| Keyword / Attribute | Implication |
|---|---|
| `ssl_mode: disable` / `ssl_mode: none` | DB connections without SSL |
| `require_secure_transport: OFF` | No forced TLS on DB connections |
| `transit_encryption: false` | Cache/DB data sent in cleartext |
| `in_transit_encryption_enabled: false` | Unencrypted in-flight data |
| `tls_minimum_version: none` | No TLS version enforcement |

---

### 6. Cookie & Session Security Flags
Web-facing resource configurations missing secure transmission flags.

| Keyword / Attribute | Implication |
|---|---|
| `secure: false` (cookie attribute) | Cookie sent over HTTP |
| `secure_flag: disabled` | Session tokens exposed to cleartext channel |
| `cookie_secure: false` | Insecure cookie transmission |
| `samesite: none` without `secure` | Cookie transmitted insecurely |

---

### 7. Certificate & SSL Verification Disabled
Settings that bypass certificate validation, enabling MITM or downgrade attacks.

| Keyword / Attribute | Implication |
|---|---|
| `ssl_verify: false` / `verify_ssl: false` | No certificate validation |
| `certificate_validation: disabled` | Accepts invalid/self-signed certs |
| `insecure_skip_verify: true` | TLS verification bypassed |
| `tls_skip_verify: true` | Channel integrity not verified |

---

### 8. Webhook & Notification URLs
Outbound integrations configured with unencrypted endpoints.

| Keyword / Attribute | Implication |
|---|---|
| `webhook_url: http://...` | Webhook sending data over HTTP |
| `notification_endpoint: http://...` | Sensitive notifications in cleartext |
| `callback_url: http://...` | Authentication callbacks unencrypted |
| `target_url: http://...` | Data forwarded in cleartext |

---

## Summary of High-Signal Keywords

```
http://, ftp://, telnet://, smtp://
https_only, require_ssl, ssl_enabled, tls_enabled
enforce_https, secure_transfer, transit_encryption
minimum_tls_version, ssl_policy, min_protocol_version
ssl_mode: disable, require_secure_transport: OFF
insecure_skip_verify, ssl_verify: false
secure: false (cookies)
port: 80, port: 21, port: 23
protocol: HTTP (on listeners/endpoints)
encryption_in_transit: disabled
```

---

## Detection Logic Summary

| Detection Signal | Severity Indicator |
|---|---|
| Explicit `false` on any HTTPS/TLS enforcement flag | **High** |
| Protocol attribute set to insecure variant | **High** |
| Deprecated TLS version permitted | **Medium–High** |
| Port 80 listener without redirect to 443 | **Medium–High** |
| SSL verification bypass flag set to `true` | **High** |
| Cookie `secure` flag missing or `false` | **Medium** |
| Webhook/callback URL using `http://` | **Medium–High** |
